adjudication.rationale: The diff adds two new controller specs (spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb and spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb) that only assert each controller is a subclass of Admin::AdminController. The new controllers themselves implement behaviorful actions (EmbeddableHostsController#create/update/destroy and EmbeddingController#show/update) including cases where records may be nil (e.g., update/destroy look up by id and then call save_host/destroy). None of those action paths are exercised by the added specs, so the finding about lack of meaningful coverage is directly verifiable from the diff.
